metaTitle: Custom Running Counter Mats | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom running counter mats for your race or event. Durable, non-slip mats with full-color imprint. Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom running counter mats are designed for race directors and event planners who need durable, high-traction mats that stay put during packet pickup or registration. Made from heavy-duty vinyl with a non-slip backing, these mats resist curling and shifting even on slick tables. Add your race logo, sponsor logos, or directional graphics using full-color screen printing or digital transfer. Choose from standard sizes like 18" x 24" or custom dimensions to fit your registration tables. They wipe clean easily and hold up to heavy use across multiple events.
heroAltText: Custom running counter mat with race logo and sponsor graphics on a registration table
